items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Had a Spanish teacher also was interested in music but we only learned Spanish songs from him.

ctx.x: Were there any music teachers along the way, or any people in your music system that were in any way influential to you?

There was a teacher in high school named Arnold Warziel. I think he inspired me more than any other teacher I’ve ever had though. He got us to listen. I was taking a music appreciation course and he got us to listen to the symphonies and the ballets and identify the instruments and identify the movements and so forth. I had never done that before. I had a greater appreciation for what I was listening to. He was on the install that in us. It was very good at that. It was the only teacher had like that. Maybe he…
